title: Audio AI
description: Composable adapters for speech, general audio, music, signal processing, and audio-language research.

adapters.title: Speech understanding
adapters.description: ASR, speech translation, diarization, speaker/language/emotion recognition, and spoken-language understanding.
discovery_questions: Which acoustic, linguistic, temporal, speaker, or domain condition creates a stable error mode?
novelty_traps: Applying a generic language or vision method to ASR without an audio-forced interaction.

adapters.title: Speech generation
adapters.description: TTS, voice conversion, expressive speech, singing voice, and controllable synthesis.
discovery_questions: Where do intelligibility, identity, prosody, emotion, duration, or naturalness diverge?
novelty_traps: Optimizing a proxy metric without calibrated perceptual evidence.

adapters.title: Interactive speech systems
adapters.description: Speech-to-speech, real-time dialogue, duplex interaction, interruption, and turn-taking.
discovery_questions: Which perception, reasoning, generation, or scheduling stage breaks natural interaction?
novelty_traps: Reporting isolated model latency while ignoring end-to-end conversational timing.

adapters.title: General audio understanding
adapters.description: Acoustic events, captioning, audio QA, temporal grounding, scene analysis, and spatial understanding.
discovery_questions: Which temporal, spatial, polyphonic, or semantic relation is systematically missed?
novelty_traps: Treating label-space expansion as a new understanding mechanism.

adapters.title: General audio generation and editing
adapters.description: Text-to-audio, Foley, sound effects, continuation, inpainting, editing, and spatial audio generation.
discovery_questions: Where do prompt alignment, event timing, acoustic quality, diversity, or edit locality fail?
novelty_traps: Selecting attractive samples or relying on one embedding score.

adapters.title: Music understanding
adapters.description: Transcription, retrieval, structure, tagging, source analysis, and music information retrieval.
discovery_questions: Which rhythmic, harmonic, structural, instrumental, or cultural factor breaks representation transfer?
novelty_traps: Claiming universal music understanding from one Western genre or corpus.

adapters.title: Music generation and production
adapters.description: Text- or music-conditioned composition, accompaniment, multitrack production, song generation, editing, and long-form audio music.
discovery_questions: Where do long-range form, motif, rhythm, harmony, instrumentation, control, or originality break?
novelty_traps: Short cherry-picked clips, culturally narrow metrics, or prompt alignment mistaken for musical quality.

adapters.title: Audio restoration, separation, and coding
adapters.description: Enhancement, denoising, dereverberation, separation, bandwidth extension, neural codecs, and restoration.
discovery_questions: Which distortion, interference, bitrate, or domain regime exposes a perceptually meaningful failure?
novelty_traps: Optimizing a distortion metric that conflicts with perception or downstream utility.

adapters.title: Audio-language and multimodal models
adapters.description: AudioLLMs, speech language models, audio-visual models, agents, temporal grounding, and audio reasoning.
discovery_questions: Which information is lost or misused across encoder, connector, language model, and generation interfaces?
novelty_traps: Attaching an existing encoder to an LLM and treating integration as a new reasoning method.

adapters.title: Encoder and discriminative model
adapters.description: Audio frontends, encoders, classifiers, CTC-style heads, and representation models.
discovery_questions: How do temporal resolution, depth, receptive field, and representation redundancy affect the task?
novelty_traps: Assuming the encoder is the bottleneck before stage-wise measurement.

adapters.title: Encoder-decoder and sequence-to-sequence
adapters.description: Attention or transducer systems that map acoustic sequences to text, labels, or acoustic outputs.
discovery_questions: Which alignment, exposure, latency, or cross-attention behavior limits the system?
novelty_traps: Importing a standard sequence model without an audio-specific mechanism.

adapters.title: Continuous waveform or spectrogram generation
adapters.description: Models that directly or hierarchically generate continuous acoustic representations.
discovery_questions: Where do phase, high-frequency detail, long-range structure, and conditioning interact?
novelty_traps: Spectral reconstruction gains without perceptual or task evidence.

adapters.title: Codec-token autoregressive generation
adapters.description: Autoregressive language models over one or more neural audio-codec streams.
discovery_questions: How do codebook delay, sequence length, hierarchy, and exposure error affect generation?
novelty_traps: Reordering known codec streams without a measured modeling or systems consequence.

adapters.title: Masked and iterative token generation
adapters.description: Parallel or iterative masked prediction over symbolic or codec representations.
discovery_questions: Which confidence schedule, dependency, or refinement order limits quality and speed?
novelty_traps: Reusing an image or text masking schedule without audio-structured evidence.

adapters.title: Diffusion and flow generation
adapters.description: Discrete or continuous diffusion, score models, flow matching, and iterative acoustic generation.
discovery_questions: Which solver, noise path, conditioning, or representation causes the quality-speed tradeoff?
novelty_traps: Changing sampler steps without a new solver, objective, or audio-dependent mechanism.

adapters.title: Vocoder and neural codec
adapters.description: Waveform decoders, residual quantizers, tokenizers, and acoustic rendering stages.
discovery_questions: Which bitrate, codebook, decoder, or domain factor controls perceptual and downstream loss?
novelty_traps: Reporting reconstruction metrics without downstream or perceptual validation.

adapters.title: Hybrid, cascaded, and streaming system
adapters.description: Multi-stage speech/audio pipelines, streaming models, and mixed generative architectures.
discovery_questions: Which interface, buffer, scheduler, or error propagation dominates end-to-end behavior?
novelty_traps: Optimizing one stage while ignoring cascade quality and latency.

adapters.title: Perceptual generation quality and control
adapters.description: Objectives, architectures, decoding, and controls that claim to change perceived generated-audio behavior.
discovery_questions: Which reproducible perceptual or controllability failure is not explained by current objective metrics?
novelty_traps: Claiming quality or control from uncalibrated proxies or selected examples.

adapters.title: Audio preference optimization and RL
adapters.description: Reward, preference, policy, and credit-assignment methods for perceptual audio generation.
discovery_questions: Where do perception, reward, temporal credit, identity, structure, and language conditioning disagree?
novelty_traps: A generic PPO or DPO recipe with an audio reward-model label.

adapters.title: Reference-based audio task evaluation
adapters.description: Ground-truth recognition, translation, tagging, localization, or downstream task evidence with slice analysis.
discovery_questions: Which duration, language, speaker, overlap, noise, event, or domain slices alter the result?
novelty_traps: One aggregate metric hiding leakage, subgroup failures, or model-specific behavior.

adapters.title: Signal-reference and downstream evaluation
adapters.description: Matched signal metrics combined with perceptual or downstream-task validation.
discovery_questions: Do signal distortion, perception, and downstream utility agree across conditions?
novelty_traps: Optimizing a metric used in training and treating it as independent evaluation.

adapters.title: Perceptual generation evaluation
adapters.description: Quality, intelligibility, identity, alignment, controllability, diversity, and preference evidence for generated audio.
discovery_questions: Which perceptual claim lacks a calibrated objective surrogate?
novelty_traps: Unvalidated proxy metrics or cherry-picked listening examples.

adapters.title: Interactive and streaming evaluation
adapters.description: First response, real-time factor, interruption, buffering, quality, throughput, and end-to-end interaction evidence.
discovery_questions: How do latency and quality change with duration, chunking, load, and interruptions?
novelty_traps: Offline average latency presented as interactive performance.

adapters.title: Musical structure evaluation
adapters.description: Rhythm, harmony, motif, form, instrumentation, long-range coherence, style, and cross-cultural evidence.
discovery_questions: Which local and long-range musical properties are independently measured?
novelty_traps: Short clips or Western-only descriptors presented as general musical quality.

adapters.title: Audio safety, identity, and memorization evaluation
adapters.description: Near-duplicate leakage, speaker identity, copyrighted content, watermarking, provenance, and misuse evidence.
discovery_questions: Can the output reproduce protected content, identity, or training examples beyond the declared threat model?
novelty_traps: Safety conclusions from prompt refusal alone or filename-level deduplication.

adapters.title: Packed audio artifacts
adapters.description: Generate samples in jobfs and persist archives, manifests, aggregate metrics, and a small curated listening bundle.
discovery_questions: Can generated samples and evaluation features be consolidated before durable publication?
novelty_traps: Publishing one persistent file per utterance, prompt, seed, or generated sample.

adapters.title: Content-level leakage control
adapters.description: Deduplicate and split by content, speaker, recording, song, stem, prompt source, and near-neighbor evidence.
discovery_questions: Which identities or near-duplicate content can cross train, selection, and evaluation boundaries?
novelty_traps: File-name deduplication or random clip splits treated as contamination control.
